description: Canada's National Earthquake Scenario Catalogue - Georgia Strait - Magnitude 4.9 is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. In 1997, a magnitude 4.6 earthquake occurred 3 to 4 km beneath the Strait of Georgia, near Vancouver. This scenario visualizes the effects of that event if it occurred today with a magnitude of 4.9. A magnitude 7.0 Georgia Strait scenario is also provided, and represents a less likely but more consequential case for comparison. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are Sciences de la terre, Protection civile, Tremblement de terre, Carte géologique, Earth sciences. It offers 11 resource(s) in ESRI REST, GPKG, HTML, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2023-06-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
